job.title: General Registration
job.description:
Balpara provides leading engineering, design and surveying services tailored to the specific needs of our clients, no matter their project size or scope.

Here in our Oakleigh office, we have a range of opportunities including Electrical Detailers, Electrical Draftsperson, Electrical Designers, Surveyors, Team Leaders and many more.

These opportunities are offered in traineeships, secondment or permanent contracts, depending on the needs of our office and our client’s office.

We encourage you to register your details by clicking ‘apply now’, and if your experience aligns with our services, one of our team members will reach out for a confidential conversation!
